Proposition
[Local holonomy parametrization] 1. Proposition 5.1\group deformation theorySource: thurston:page-0097, thurston:page-0098 ↗ thurston-ch05-holonomy-deformation-equivalence Nearby $(G,X)$--structures on a compact manifold are classified, up to the preceding equivalence, by nearby holonomy representations modulo conjugation by small elements of $G$.
Proof

\sketch Represent $M$ by a disk with overlap data on its boundary. Perturbing the holonomy perturbs the finitely many identifications and hence gives a nearby structure. Conjugate holonomies are made equal by a small coordinate change; restriction to smaller disks then supplies the required equivalence.

□
